identity: They are a race of inter-dimensional beings.  These guys are more metal than man in my opinion and use automated machinery to do their fighting and heavy lifting.  They do understand English to a certain extent and when talking they use a strange dialect they like to call Anglic.  They are here to mine this place of any useful metal, gather any tech they deem worth saving and maybe even grab a couple of survivors to join their ranks before they move out.
